Package app.model

Class User

java.lang.Object
app.model.User
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class User extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a user in the photo album application. A user can manage albums, photos, and custom tag rules. Implements Serializable for persistent local storage.
Author:
Toma Takamatsu
